import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Calculate the average Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep for each Occupation
occupation_sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean().reset_index()

# Melt the DataFrame to long format for easier plotting with seaborn's barplot
# This allows 'Sleep Duration' and 'Quality of Sleep' to be treated as different categories (hue)
occupation_sleep_metrics_melted = occupation_sleep_metrics.melt(
    id_vars='Occupation',
    var_name='Metric',
    value_name='Average Value'
)

# Set a professional seaborn style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Create a grouped bar plot
ax = sns.barplot(
    data=occupation_sleep_metrics_melted,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Average Value',
    hue='Metric',
    palette='viridis', # A colorblind-friendly palette
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=0.7
)

# Add labels and title for clarity
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep by Occupation', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=14)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability, especially if there are many occupations
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=12)
plt.yticks(fontsize=12)

# Add a legend to distinguish between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.legend(title='Sleep Metric', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left')

# Add value labels on top of the bars for more precise reading
for container in ax.containers:
    ax.bar_label(container, fmt='%.1f', label_type='edge', padding=3, fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from overlapping and make space for legend
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.95, 1]) # Adjust rect to make space for the legend outside

# Save the figure as 'output.png'
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
